sections.title: Look Back (Review)
paragraphs: One time as Jesus and His followers were crossing a lake in a boat. Jesus fell asleep in the boat and a storm came up. His followers were afraid and began to wake up Jesus. Speaking to the wind and the waves, Jesus commanded them to stop — and they stopped! His followers were amazed and began to say that even nature obeyed His command.

sections.title: Look Up (New Teaching)
paragraphs: Another time Jesus taught, “The miracles that I do in my Father’s name speak for Me. I know my sheep and they follow Me. I give them eternal life and will never perish. No one can snatch them out of My hand.” These miracles and teachings prove that Jesus is God!
Let’s read some verses from the Holy Scriptures, the Bible, that relate to this story.

These verses teach us that God's grace seeks the lost. Jesus said, "I am the good shepherd" — a shepherd does not wait for the sheep to find him; he goes out to seek them. He keeps His sheep secure. Jesus proved His love for us by laying down His life through His sacrifice on the cross. He did this because without His sacrifice there is no salvation. Jesus said, "I am the way, and the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father except through Me." This grace is offered to all who trust in Him.
What did you learn from these Scriptures?
Think a little — how will you practice what you have learned?

sections.title: Look Forward (Obedience)
paragraphs: Do you think Jesus can be trusted to lead us as our good shepherd? Let’s ask Jesus to help us know his love and trust in him.
I hope you enjoyed this story. When can we meet again?
Do you think someone else should hear this story?
